headline_findings: stable-diffusion.cpp (MIT, CUDA/Vulkan, GGUF) is the embeddable local image core: sd-server speaks OpenAI, WebUI and native async APIs plus an embedded web UI
On discrete GPUs sd.cpp runs ~1.5-3.7x slower per 1024px image than ComfyUI but needs far less VRAM and no Python stack; FLUX.1-schnell Q4 and SDXL-Turbo fit the 8 GB Ampere card
Licences split the model menu: schnell/Qwen-Image-v1/SD3.5 are commercial-friendly while FLUX-dev and Qwen-Image-2.1 are non-commercial-only and must be gated
LM Studio and Jan ship no local diffusion (cloud plugins/proxies and image-input only), so bundled offline image gen is a real Cerebro differentiator

items.fit_reference_machine: Best fit: native CUDA build on the RTX 3070 Ti; GGUF quants plus CPU offload let 12B models run in 8 GB VRAM + 32 GB RAM at batch 1.
items.harness_integration: Sidecar sd-server/sd-cli binaries (pinned version + SHA) spawned with argv only, same supervisor pattern as llama.cpp; or link via diffusion-rs.
items.name: stable-diffusion.cpp core engine
items.quality_cost: q8_0 near-lossless vs fp16; q4 small drop; q2_k visible degradation (side-by-side reference images in flux doc).
items.reported_gain: No tok/s metric; footprint win: FLUX.1 diffusion weights 12.1 GB at q8_0 down to 3.7 GB at q2_k per official table.
items.what: MIT-licensed pure C/C++ (ggml) diffusion runtime covering SD1.x-3.5, FLUX.1/2, Qwen-Image, Z-Image, Chroma and Wan/LTX video.
items.where_implemented: leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp sd-cli binary; backends CPU/CUDA/Vulkan/Metal/OpenCL/SYCL; ckpt/safetensors/GGUF + convert mode

items.fit_reference_machine: Ideal: localhost HTTP keeps GPU buffers hot across jobs; model fixed at server start so one model resident per process.
items.harness_integration: Spawn sd-server as child, drive POST /sdcpp/v1/img_gen and poll jobs; fall back to OpenAI-compat endpoints for third-party clients.
items.name: sd-server API mode + embedded web UI
items.quality_cost: None; same pixels as CLI. Server ignores prompt-embedded <lora:...> tags, LoRA must use structured fields.
items.reported_gain: No per-image speedup claimed; avoids per-call model reload (server caches model in memory); embedded web UI added 2026-04-11.
items.what: HTTP server with OpenAI (/v1/images/*), WebUI (/sdapi/v1/txt2img|img2img) and native async sdcpp (img_gen/vid_gen/jobs) APIs.
items.where_implemented: leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp examples/server; OpenAI, sdapi and sdcpp API families plus sd_cpp_extra_args extension

items.fit_reference_machine: Top quality pick for 8 GB: q4 (~6.4 GB) or q2_k (~3.7 GB) diffusion weights + CLIP on CPU; 4-step schnell keeps 1024px times lowest of the FLUX family.
items.harness_integration: Ship schnell-q4 GGUF preset with cfg-scale 1.0, euler, 4 steps, --clip-on-cpu; offer q8_0 only with CPU offload.
items.name: FLUX.1-schnell GGUF path (Apache-2.0)
items.quality_cost: Distilled 4-step model: slightly softer fine detail than 28-50-step dev, still strong prompt following.
items.reported_gain: 4 inference steps vs ~28-50 for dev-class models at 1024px; Apache-2.0 allows commercial use.
items.what: 12B rectified-flow transformer distilled for 1-4-step 1024px generation, released by Black Forest Labs under Apache-2.0.
items.where_implemented: black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell HF repo; leejet preconverted GGUF quants; sd.cpp flux.md recipe

items.fit_reference_machine: Runs on 8 GB with the same quant/offload recipe as schnell, but slower per image (many more steps); gate behind licence prompt.
items.harness_integration: Hide behind non-commercial acknowledgement toggle; reuse schnell pipeline with higher default steps; Kontext enables edit mode.
items.name: FLUX.1-dev / FLUX.1-Kontext / FLUX.2-dev (licence-gated)
items.quality_cost: Highest FLUX.1 fidelity and real image editing (Kontext); dev needs ~28-50 steps so slower than schnell.
items.reported_gain: Quality gain over schnell at cost of ~7-12x more steps; no speed gain. Licence is the constraint, not VRAM.
items.what: Higher-fidelity FLUX variants plus Kontext image editing, all under BFL Non-Commercial License v1.1.1 (no commercial/production use).
items.where_implemented: black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev LICENSE.md v1.1.1; sd.cpp kontext/edit docs; FLUX.2-dev support since 2025-11-30

items.fit_reference_machine: Heavy: Q4_K_M Edit GGUF alone ~13.1 GB so the 8 GB card needs --offload-to-cpu/--diffusion-fa into 32 GB RAM; usable but slow.
items.harness_integration: Advanced preset: diffusion GGUF + Qwen2.5-VL Q4 text encoder + safetensors VAE, 1024px/40 steps/euler/cfg 2.5/flow-shift 3.
items.name: Qwen-Image / Qwen-Image-Edit GGUF (Apache-2.0)
items.quality_cost: Best-in-class open text rendering (esp. CJK) and precise editing; Q4 quant small drop vs bf16 per community comparisons.
items.reported_gain: No speed gain: 40-50 steps at 1024px; strength is text accuracy and multi-image edit consistency, not images/sec.
items.what: 20B MMDiT foundation model family (Apache-2.0) with standout text rendering and single/multi-image editing variants.
items.where_implemented: QwenLM/Qwen-Image repo; sd.cpp qwen_image docs since 2025-10-12; Unsloth GGUF + sd-cli recipe

items.fit_reference_machine: Compact 7B visual component should fit 8 GB better than v1, but commercial use is banned by licence; treat as personal-use preview.
items.harness_integration: Pin sd.cpp build with Day-0 support; show Research-licence banner; do not bundle weights, link external download.
items.name: Qwen-Image-2.1 Day-0 support (non-commercial flip)
items.what: Qwen image successor with Day-0 sd.cpp support 2026-09-20, but licence flipped to Qwen Research non-commercial-only.
items.where_implemented: leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp news 2026-09-20 + qwen_image_2.1 docs; Qwen-Image-2.1 LICENSE (Research Agreement 2026-09-20)

items.fit_reference_machine: Safest 1024px defaults on 8 GB: SDXL footprints of a few GB; SD3.5-Medium/Large-Turbo step up quality within Community licence.
items.harness_integration: Default presets: SDXL-Turbo few-step fast mode; SD3.5-Large-Turbo quality mode; record Community-licence attribution requirement.
items.name: SDXL-Turbo / SD3.5 practical 8 GB defaults
items.quality_cost: Turbo few-step: good composition, softer micro-detail; SD3.5-Large-Turbo recovers most quality at more steps.
items.reported_gain: SDXL 30 steps cfg 4 on RX 7800XT: ComfyUI 12.36 s warm vs sd.cpp Vulkan 29.63 s (same issue thread, batch 1).
items.what: Stability models under the Community Licence (free incl. commercial under $1M revenue): SDXL family and SD3.5 Large/Medium/Turbo.
items.where_implemented: stability.ai/license Community tier; sd.cpp sd.md/sd3.md docs; stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3.5-large HF repo

items.fit_reference_machine: Designed for low VRAM: 9-step Z-Image-Turbo class is the fastest path to a decent 1024px image on the 3070 Ti.
items.harness_integration: Add a sub-30 s 1024px preset (few steps, cfg 1) as the budget default alongside SDXL-Turbo.
items.name: Z-Image-Turbo class compact distilled models
items.quality_cost: Few-step distilled look: clean composition, less micro-texture than 40-step models; good enough for drafts and icons.
items.reported_gain: RX 7800XT batch 1, 9 steps: ComfyUI 20.84 s vs sd.cpp Vulkan 34.57 s per 1024px image (same thread).
items.what: Compact few-step distilled image models (Z-Image family supported since 2025-12-01) targeting fast low-VRAM generation.
items.where_implemented: leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp z_image docs + news 2025-12-01; issue #1215 benchmark table

items.fit_reference_machine: Speed leader on the same GPU but needs a full Python+Torch+CUDA stack and GBs of deps; fine as optional BYO engine, not bundled.
items.harness_integration: Optional external target: POST workflow JSON to /prompt on a portable/manual install, poll /history; never target Desktop builds.
items.name: ComfyUI headless /prompt API backend
items.quality_cost: Reference quality (native PyTorch, no GGUF loss); sd.cpp trails it ~1.6-3.7x per image in the reported comparisons.
items.reported_gain: FLUX.2-klein-4B 1024px 4 steps: ~5 s ComfyUI vs ~25 s sd.cpp; RTX 4090 CUDA ~10.5 it/s vs sd.cpp ~6.7 it/s (issue #1215).
items.what: Node-graph Python diffusion frontend whose manual/Portable installs expose a /prompt + /history (+websocket) API for headless use.
items.where_implemented: ComfyUI manual/Portable installs (NOT Desktop); workflow API-format JSON submitted to the local server port

items.fit_reference_machine: Not a backend target: the installed Comfy-Desktop copy cannot run headless or serve LAN/child-process requests.
items.harness_integration: Detect and ignore Comfy-Desktop installs; auto-discover portable/manual servers or prompt the user to install one.
items.name: Comfy Desktop headless limitation
items.quality_cost: None (no image path through Desktop without GUI); snapshot/multi-instance features irrelevant to a harness.
items.reported_gain: No gain; official FAQ states Desktop requires a graphical session and has no server-only mode.
items.what: Official Comfy Desktop FAQ: no headless/server/remote mode; headless deployments must use manual or Portable installs.
items.where_implemented: docs.comfy.org Comfy Desktop FAQ entry 'Can I run Comfy Desktop in headless or server mode?'

items.quality_cost: Tiled VAE/TAESD slightly softens decode; ESRGAN 4x adds real detail on top of diffusion output.
items.reported_gain: No speed gain; capability gain: full edit pipeline (txt2img, img2img, mask inpaint, hires second pass, model upscale).

items.fit_reference_machine: Not recommended as default: video diffusion is VRAM-hungry; short low-res clips only, expect CPU offload and minutes per clip.
items.harness_integration: Expose vid_gen jobs as experimental with strict frame/resolution caps and clear licence labels per video model.
items.name: Wan 2.1/2.2 + LTX-2.3/2.5 video generation
items.quality_cost: Low-res few-second clips on 8 GB; quality and temporal coherence far below datacenter GPU output.
items.what: Text/image-to-video models (Wan2.1/2.2, LTX-2.3/2.5, MiniMax-H3, HunyuanVideo) driven through sd.cpp async vid_gen jobs.
items.where_implemented: sd.cpp wan.md/ltx2.md docs; POST /sdcpp/v1/vid_gen with video_frames/fps/high_noise_sample_params

items.fit_reference_machine: Zero local VRAM use (cloud), but violates Cerebro's fully-offline goal; useful only as a negative benchmark.
items.harness_integration: Treat as competitive gap to beat: offline one-click 1024px vs their login+credits+upload round-trips.
items.name: LM Studio / Jan image-generation gap
items.quality_cost: Cloud plugins add latency, accounts, per-gen credits and cold starts (20-60 s noted for idle HF endpoints).
items.reported_gain: No local gain exists: LM Studio image plugin calls HuggingFace Inference API; Jan v0.6.9 image support is input-only.
items.what: Neither harness bundles local diffusion: LM Studio generates via cloud HF Inference plugins; Jan supports image uploads, not synthesis.
items.where_implemented: LM Studio Hub image plugin (generate_image via HF Inference API); Jan v0.6.9 changelog multimodal-input section
